signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds at a $3B valuation and is unveiling new AI capabilities at Lex Summit

email.body1:
Christian, saw Filevine raise $400M at a $3B valuation with new AI launches lined up for Lex Summit.

At that scale the org has more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that's where pipeline and forecast accuracy slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christian, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, the company number jumps faster than headcount can. As the EVP carrying it, the hard part is knowing how many meetings the whole org needs to book to hit it, before the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christian, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other well-funded legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Carrying the number through a big raise and AI launches is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a legal-tech org? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
